main_issue: Who will complete Agent D's unfinished analysis section before Thursday's pitch, given D's bereavement; resolved with D running the analysis from home and C doing the data prep.

A-B.evidence: Both express sympathy and want to cover for D (T3, T6); B declines to help with the analysis (T12, T19) while A accepts the plan, but no conflict.

A-C.evidence: A asks C to do data prep (T20); C initially says no knowledge of analysis (T14) but then agrees to do the data prep (T23).

A-D.evidence: A first says 'Don't worry about anything' (T3, T9), then accepts D's offer to run the analysis from home (T18); both endorse the plan.

B-C.evidence: Both say they can't do the analysis (T12, T14); C later agrees to data prep while B declines (T19, T23), but they never address each other.

B-D.evidence: B tells D to go be with family (T6); D thanks all of them (T10) and proposes a plan B doesn't contribute to, but doesn't oppose.

C-D.evidence: C asks what data prep involves (T21); D explains and C agrees (T23); D thanks C (T24).
